item.text: {"summary":"The failures share a clear cause in `LiteralPolicy`: it searches for any byte in the delimiter and reports consuming only one byte. That breaks multi-byte literal boundaries in all three failing tests. The existing empty-delimiter special case and single-character `ByString` fast path are separate.","hypotheses":["`LiteralPolicy::Find` should locate the full delimiter substring, and `LiteralPolicy::Length` should report its full length; this accounts for the extra empty fields in `Split.APIExamples`, `Split.UTF8`, and `Split.SubstrDelimiter`."],"queries":[],"reads":[],"ready":true}
